title: Remove residual antiforgery exemptions from browser mutation controllers
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that Chat, Governance, MaintenanceAgent, Memories, Pages, and Tasks controllers retain controller-level IgnoreAntiforgeryToken while exposing cookie-authenticated browser mutations. Existing global antiforgery work did not remove these residual exemptions. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Controllers/*.cs and AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenFilter.cs. Remove exemptions or isolate only explicit non-browser protocols, then add browser mutation regression coverage.
